content: Stripe vs Paddle vs Lemon Squeezy differ primarily on Merchant-of-Record status: Stripe leaves the seller responsible for sales-tax collection/remittance across jurisdictions (mitigated by add-on Stripe Tax) but costs ~2.9%+/usr/bin/bash.30 and offers the deepest custom-integration control (Checkout Sessions, Elements, webhooks); Paddle/Lemon Squeezy act as MoR (they handle tax/compliance) at a higher ~5%+/usr/bin/bash.50 fee, aimed at digital/SaaS products selling across many tax jurisdictions. For a single-location physical-goods retailer (one state/jurisdiction, simple sales tax), Stripe's lower fees and first-party ASP.NET/Next.js integration outweigh MoR convenience, which mainly benefits multi-jurisdiction digital/SaaS sellers.
